results.response: It is a support tool for review decisions, not a sales forecast or ROI claim.
The synthetic example keeps 2.1 million from 12.4 million after an 83% filter. It links to public source posts, but accuracy is not shown.
It reads posts in context and groups similar meanings into one signal. The model and threshold are not specified.
Evergreen supports steady work, while trending and event-driven signals need faster review. It does not prove ROI.
Each signal links to public source posts. Privacy, consent, and retention controls are not specified.
Review 5–10 signals, collect comments, and agree a cadence. A next-month launch is not committed.
The material does not show precision or recall, so those metrics need verification by source.
Start with Signals, then use the situation screen to open public source posts. The cadence remains a team choice.
